envelope.description: Add addAssignee to the tracker port and the GitHub adapter

body.title: Add addAssignee to the tracker port and the GitHub adapter
body.summary: Add the add-only addAssignee(issue, who) to TrackerPort in src/workflow/tracker/port.ts and implement it in the GitHub adapter (src/workflow/tracker/github-adapter.ts) beside setAssignee: it adds who without removing anyone, re-reads, and returns the assignees read back. setAssignee stays for release. This Task adds the method as the additive sc1 amendment AMD-315d510cb28100e2-12, which is still pending with s1 and needs its approval, as was done for findIssues; it changes no existing method. Other test doubles that cast to TrackerPort are unaffected.
acceptanceChecks: addAssignee adds the login without removing another assignee and returns the assignees read back
A failed or timed-out step is reported as a classified PortResult failure and is not retried

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: addAssignee adds without removing, returns the assignees read back and reports a failed step without a retry
